name: Echo
blurb: A rank, remembered until it comes round again.
rule: When this card comes home, the next card of the same rank to come home this hand pays double spark and gains a charge.

name: Lantern
blurb: One card lit, and the whole suit reads easier.
rule: While this card is awake, every card of its suit earns one and a half times as much.

name: Kindling
blurb: Charge travels to the cards either side of it.
rule: When this card gains a charge, its rank-neighbours in the same suit each gain a charge.

name: Twin
blurb: Two cards, one fate. The wire the rest hang from.
rule: When either twin wakes or gains a charge, the other wakes if it is asleep and otherwise gains a charge.

name: Anchor
blurb: Something to hold on to when the deck is cut.
rule: This card keeps its wake and its charge through Cut the Deck.

name: Wild
blurb: It fits wherever you put it, and asks no questions.
rule: In the tableau this card may be placed on any card.

name: Mirror
blurb: Red on one side, black on the other, both at once.
rule: This card counts as both colours.

name: Glass
blurb: You can see it coming, which is most of the game.
rule: This card is dealt face-up even where the game deals face-down.

name: Heavy
blurb: It lands hard enough to count, wherever it lands.
rule: Moving this card in the tableau gains it a charge, though it never wakes it.

name: Tithe
blurb: It gives up its own earnings to the rest of the suit.
rule: This card earns nothing, and every other card of its suit earns a quarter more.
